game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Cavern, repeat each round: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the loop_runs value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about loop_runs to power up the dwarf scout and open the supply cache.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Condition Builder
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Condition Builder' (Week 4 slot 14), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Mushroom Cavern'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_runs changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Mushroom Cavern.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
